review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one new definition, `symmetricSource`, which is the coordinate divergence of the j-th column of H·gradientColumns(Du). The rest is two lemmas and a bundled theorem. I looked at the project's `coordinateDivergence` (a sum of `fderiv` along `Pi.single`), `gradientColumns` (the transpose of `LinearMap.toMatrix'` of the derivative), `Coord3` and `Mat3`. Mathlib has no divergence operator and no matrix-valued Jacobian definition that would compete with these. A grep for `def divergence` and `def jacobian` found only an unrelated ring-theory `jacobian`. Other `coordinateDivergence` definitions exist in the repository (Geometry/SmoothYau and Combinatorics/Progressions), but they differ in signature and are outside this file, so I did not treat them as a duplicate here. `symmetricSource` is a specific named composite of existing project definitions, not a competing version of a Mathlib concept. The lemmas are theorem-level, which the rubric excludes. I found no justified finding.
